full_judgment: 3. The case of the petitioners, in short, is that G.R. Case No. 12 of 1985 of Madhabpur Upazilla arose regarding the tank and bank in plot nos. 1833 and 1832 khatian No. 1780, village Cnatiain. The petitioners claim to be the owner of the plots in question. The opposite party Nos. 1 to 3 wanted to grab the said property by any means, failing in persuasion they submitted a petition to the U.N.O. Madhabpur to get the property purchased or in the alternative to requisition the same with a view to acquire the same for the public purpose but they failed. Thereafter the petitioners apprehending the danger filed a Title suit being Title Suit No. 9, 1985 before the Subordinate Judge and prayed for temporary injunction. The attempts of the opposite parties thus having failed, they took recourse to and tried to take possession of the tank a bank in question by application of sheer force. That on 19.2.85 the opposite parties trespassed into the tank of the petitioners and an occurrence took place leading to the filing of the present i.e. G.R. Case No. 12 of 1985. The petitioners submit that the opposite parties without any legal cause, out of sheer high handedness, were trying to grab the property and cause unnecessary harassment to these petitioners. The First Information Report was file by one Nuruzzaman, bringing the police into the scene and the police started investigation into the case to the great harassment of the petitioner. Police could not submit the charge sheet within 30 days. That time for investigation being exhausted, the learned Magistrate extended time by 30 days up to 18.5.85. The investigating officer could not complete the investigation till 18.5.85. Thereafter an application by the Investigating officer was filed before the learned Sessions Judge, Sylhet of extending time for another 30 days on 17.6.8 to complete the investigation. On failure by police to complete the investigation by 17.6.85 the proceeding in G R. Case No. 12 of 1985 was stopped and the accused were released the Upazilla Magistrate. But after getting and of the learned Sessions Judge extending the time for investigation by another month, the Upazilla Magistrate revived the case. The Investigating Officer even after getting the extended time for one month from the Sessions Judge, could not complete the investigation within the specified time. Police again filed an application before the A.D.C. Habigonj for extension of time on 24.5.85 and the learned A.D.C. by his order dated 23.6.85 extended time for investigation by 30 days up to 17.7.85. Thereafter the Upzilla Magistrate again revived the case, by his order dated 30.6.85 that thereafter charge sheet was submitted on 18 7.85 and the court issued warrant of arrest and proclamation of attachment of property upon the petitioners on 20.7.85.
